title: koeleria hirsuta
intro: Koeleria hirsuta, commonly known as hairy June grass, is a species of perennial grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to treat various health conditions, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria hirsuta include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria hirsuta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
